Projected to score 72, they scored 65 (−7 points, 10% under); projected to allow 83.5, they allowed 87 (+3.5 points, 4% over).

The bigger miss was Rattlers' scoring (-7 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 152 against 155.5 projected (-3.5), about the 40th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±14.5).

Margin: Roos by 22 against Roos by 11.5 projected, about the 17th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±11).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Market (Line movement signal): Rattlers ×1.00, Roos ×1.02. It favored Roos, who did beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
FAMU ML (+275) at +275: the algo gave it 25% vs 26% fair (-0.9 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 26%). KC ML (-345) at -345: the algo gave it 75% vs 74% fair (+0.9 pts) — won (+0.3u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 74%). FAMU +8.5 (-115) at -115: the algo gave it 50% vs 51% fair (-0.8 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. KC -8.5 (-105) at -105: the algo gave it 50% vs 49% fair (+0.8 pts) — won (+1u); same number as the close. OVER 144.5 (-112) at -112: the algo gave it 52% vs 50% fair (+2 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. UNDER 144.5 (-108) at -108: the algo gave it 48% vs 50% fair (-2 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 56% of bets on Roos, 77% of the money — Roos covered; total: 70% of bets on the over, 37% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 94% of bets on Roos, 99% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Roos, who won and covered.

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin.

The projection landed within its normal range anyway, so the flags didn't cost it much this time.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.982 of the raw projection. It counts toward CBB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 338 graded CBB games the algo now scales scoring ×1.004 and gives home teams +1.1 points. Team corrections so far: Roos attack ×1.020, defense ×1.009 (3 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
